# Fixtures

- `ttc-alerts-2026-11-02.pb`: a real GTFS-Realtime service-alerts snapshot from
  `bustime.ttc.ca/gtfsrt/alerts`, captured 2026-11-02, used to test the protobuf decoder
  against a real producer. Contains information licensed under the
  [Open Government Licence – Toronto](https://open.toronto.ca/open-data-license/).

Static GTFS test data is synthetic and built in code: see `src/testing/fixture-feed.ts`.
